text: REST API with HTTP Basic Auth, form-encoded requests, and JSON responses
quote: It's a REST API that uses HTTP Basic Auth, accepts form-encoded requests, and returns JSON.

text: Official Node.js SDK installable via npm
Records usage events for usage-based billing
quote: This resource allows you to record usage events, which are essential for usage-based billing.

text: Item prices must match currency with plan-item prices to be compatible
quote: An item price is compatible with a plan-item price if their currencies are the same.

text: Configured webhooks fire on platform events
quote: If webhooks are configured in Chargebee, events trigger those webhooks.

text: Export jobs produce a status and downloadable file URL
quote: Export resource represents an export job and contains the status of the job and the download URL, if the job is successfully completed.

text: Official Chargebee MCP Servers let AI clients like Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex connect and use selected capabilities
quote: Connect AI clients such as Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and other MCP-compatible tools to Chargebee MCP Servers to securely access selected capabilities.

text: Custom MCP servers can be built by combining a subset of Chargebee's tool catalog for a specific use case
quote: Custom MCP servers let you combine tools from Chargebee's full tool catalog into a server tailored to your use case—for example, an invoice lookup server that exposes only the subscription and invoice tools your AI client needs.

text: API Explorer allows live, code-free API calls via a guided browser interface
quote: The API Explorer lets you make live API calls in a browser using a guided interface. Use it to test endpoints without writing code.

text: UI to allocate and manage customer privileges via Features (entitlements)
quote: Chargebee provides you an efficient UI to allocate and manage the customer privileges using Features.

text: Dunning feature sends payment-update email reminders and schedules retry intervals
quote: With Chargebee's Dunning feature, you can send email reminders to your customers asking them to update payment details and schedule payment retries at intervals to ensure revenue can be recovered.

text: Smart retry logic dynamically times payment retries based on gateway error type
quote: Chargebee's Smart retry logic retries payments at dynamic intervals based on the type of gateway transaction errors, and it acts on the hard or soft declines accordingly.

text: RevRec provides ASC 606-compliant revenue recognition covering renewals, modifications, and cancellations
quote: RevRec is fully compliant with ASC 606 revenue recognition capabilities that cover your sales activities right from contract changes (renewal, modification, cancellation)

text: AI can auto-draft product catalog items (families, plans, addons, prices, features, entitlements) from a pricing page or document
quote: Let Chargebee AI draft product families, plans, addons, charges, prices, features, and entitlements from a pricing page, document, or description.

text: Supports multi-frequency billing where each plan or addon can have its own billing period within a subscription
quote: Multi-frequency billing: Subscriptions are billed according to the billing period of each recurring item price within the subscription, whether it's a plan or addon.

text: Built-in AI assistant inside the Billing UI answers questions and completes tasks
quote: Use AI inside the Chargebee Billing UI to answer questions and complete tasks.
